description: Encrypted-mnemonic vault interop fixture. Decrypting `blob` with `password` must yield `secret`; `wrongPassword` must fail (GCM tag). Format v1: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 250000 iterations over the password with `salt` (16 B) -> AES-256-GCM key; `iv` 12 B; `ct` = ciphertext||16-byte tag; all base64. Encryption is randomized, so only decryption is vector-tested.
